svg.text: K11 Fridge and freezer: getting boxes out through the top
Built-in 178 cm fridge and freezer, top wall opened. A: one small window and a robot inside. B: four sub-lids, the carriage digs.
fridge Bosch KIR81AFE0 319 L · freezer GIN81ACE0 212 L
CLD-004 kept by both · B fails CLD-006 for unplanned boxes
dashed line: robot zone, top 350 mm
has a skirt and a heater
boxes of every stack; a deep
OPTION B — four sub-lids, dug from above
servo hook lifts one at a time, only
freezer seats: 100 mm skirt and a
top box ≈ 15–18 s, each box above
night re-sort keeps R boxes on
their own stacks, never above RTE
cut test on a used unit (CLD-007)

g.text: 1/4 A: the robot inside lifts the box into the robot zone, under the window
2/4 A: slide opens 3.4 s; the storage gripper takes the box
3/4 A: unplanned deep box: the robot moves the box above aside
4/4 A: wanted box to the window; next opening 3.4 s
1/4 B: hook lifts sub-lid 1; the box above comes out
2/4 B: it is parked on stack 2 through sub-lid 2
3/4 B: back to stack 1: the wanted box comes out
4/4 B: all lids closed; box to the cell (≈ 30 s here)
